content.text: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one file, `solution/util.py`. The cause was in `_parse_class`: it parsed ranges like `a-z` into a `ranges` list, but the returned `match` closure only tested membership in `chars`, so range members never matched. That broke both `[a-z]` and negated `[!a-c]`. The fix makes `match` also accept a character when it falls within any `(lo, hi)` range, and the negation still applies on top. I did not touch `tests/` or the public API, and I added no files.
